====================================================================
PAC-MAN ARCADE (WINDOWS EDITION)
Lead Developer: Md. Abu Rise Zunaed
====================================================================

HOW TO PLAY ON WINDOWS:

METHOD 1: INSTANT PLAY (NO COMPILER REQUIRED)
---------------------------------------------
1. Open the "web/index.html" file in Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.
2. Click "Install Pac-Man" in your browser address bar to install it as a native Windows desktop app with desktop shortcut and icon!
3. Play instantly with full keyboard controls and high scores!

METHOD 2: NATIVE WINDOWS (.EXE)
-------------------------------
1. Install MSYS2 UCRT64 from https://www.msys2.org/
2. Install gcc and SDL2:
   pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-sdl2
3. Double-click "build_windows.bat" or run "Play_Pacman.bat" to start playing!

CONTROLS:
- Arrow Keys or W / A / S / D : Move
- Space or Enter              : Start Game / Restart
- P                           : Pause / Resume
- M                           : Mute / Unmute
- Esc                         : Quit Game
